_comment: SMOKE config for the comparison_v2 family — a handful of cells that PROVE the config parses, all the new Section 2/4/6 knobs are exercised keyed==run (virialized Option-A grid + node_softening_gpc=1.0 + node_force_law='bounded' + start_size_scale=1.2), the per-cell CSV checkpoint/resume works, and the figures (incl. the mu(z) panel with Section-1 reconciled chi2) generate. NOT a physics result: 120 particles is far below convergence — it only validates the pipeline. n_steps=273 is the leapfrog-stability FLOOR for the 10.9 Gyr run (dt<0.05 Gyr), not a tuning choice. Factorial axes: 2 geometries (cube26 control + virialized) x 2 M, S co-fit over a tiny [12..20] band. Run: python sweep.py --config sweeps/comparison_v2_smoke.json
